source_handle: 32 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Reposition the alveolar socket and apply compression to stop bleeding.
